notes.title: Patch Notes for April 1st, 2025
notes.content:
[b]- added two new narrative arcs:[/b] [b]The Stain [/b] and [b]The Extradimensional [/b]. Be on the look out for strange happenings across the web. Watch your walls, watch your back, watch even your dreams. Who knows what you'll find? These arcs include a new special npp, chitter convos, stream events, sleep events, special websites and more! Be on the look out :)

[b]- added new inquires: [/b]building on our last update, players can now find new inquires around the web as they chat with denizens of the web and explore. make sure to follow your nose, no matter to what horrors it may lead you. 

[b]- added new music and sfx: [/b] some new tracks for you to head bob to have made their way to the web, in addition to new sound effects for various UI/UX elements and across events. 

[b]- new images and assets on The Web: [/b] enjoy new blinkies, gifs, avatars, and wallpapers across the strange and wonderful dark web. 

[b]- new QOL and balance changes:[/b] rest deductions now occurs when surfing on every other page.

notes.title: Update Notes for 16 March 2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*]A completely new generated internet! (very few images for now; we haven't had time to create more art for them). This includes both visual updates and content updates. No longer is the entire internet obsessed with a single band! 😂 
[*]Our new inquiry system! You can make inquiries about things you need in your stream chat or to people you befriend on the internet. This will add an extra level of strategy. As a result, some services are now much more difficult to find without actively hunting them down.
[*]Major QOL and balancing updates. Highlighted feature: rest/sleep is more balanced, which should provide a better difficulty feel. You won't lose as much rest surfing the web, but you'll lose more sleep the lower your LP is! Stay sane out there[/list]
